title: Every current of degree d > P on a subset of ℝ^P is zero
statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ with P < d, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be any set and let A ∈ 𝒟_d(U). Then A = 0. Conventions: ℝ^P = Euclid P and Hᵈ = μHE[d]. For D ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^d(D) = TestFormOn D d (smooth d-forms on ℝ^P with compact support contained in D) and 𝒟_d(D) = GeometricCurrentOn D d; ∂X = X.boundary (∂X(ω) = X(dω)). For G ⊆ ℝ^P, M_G(X) = X.massOn G is the supremum of ofReal(X(ω)) over ω ∈ 𝒟^d(D) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) ≤ 1 for all x; M(X) = X.mass = M_D(X). An IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) in D is the contract structure IMRep D d; R.action(ω) = ∫_M θ(x) ξ(x)(ω(x)) dHᵈ(x); R represents X when X(ω) = R.action(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^d(D); μ_R = R.measure = (Hᵈ⌞M).withDensity θ; X is integer multiplicity (IM, IsIntegerMultiplicity X) if some IMRep in D represents it. For V ⊆ D, ι = testFormOnInclusion regards ω ∈ 𝒟^d(V) as an element of 𝒟^d(D) with the same underlying form, and X⌞V = X.restrictDomain (V ⊆ D) ∈ 𝒟_d(V) is given by X⌞V(ω) = X(ιω). X vanishes off a set K if X(ω) = 0 for every test form ω whose tsupport is disjoint from K.
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A : GeometricCurrentOn U d), P < d → A = 0
